# eon_restore_aws_instance_types (Data Source)

Lists AWS instance types available to restore into a subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_restore_aws_instance_types" "example" {
  restore_account_id = "restore-account-id"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-example"
  volume_count       = 2
  total_volume_bytes = 1073741824
}

output "restore_aws_instance_types" {
  value = data.eon_restore_aws_instance_types.example.instance_types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region to list instance types in.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon restore account ID.
- `subnet_id` (String) AWS subnet ID to use for the restore.

### Optional

- `total_volume_bytes` (Number) Total size of guest volumes to restore, in bytes.
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of guest volumes to restore.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (List of String) Instance types available for the subnet.
